# [MCP在LangChain中的应用-01]MultiServerMCPClient编程体验
在“[FastMCP设计、原理与应用](https://blog.csdn.net/jaydenai/category_13152254.html)”系列中，我系统介绍了[MCP规范](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/)以及[FastMCP](https://gofastmcp.com/)针对它的实现(服务器端+客户端),接下来我们来介绍在LangChain中如何使用MCP。LangChain将[langchain_mcp_adapters库](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain-mcp-adapters)作为MCP客户端SDK，它以`MultiServerMCPClient`为核心，它类似于`fastmcp.client.Client`。`fastmcp.client.Client`基本是完全按照[MCP规范](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/)定义的，所以它基本上直接使用[mcp库](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol)提供的输入和输出类型。`MultiServerMCPClient`的定位不同，它会在实现MCP规范的基础上完成与LangChain编程模式的适配，这一点从[langchain_mcp_adapters库](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain-mcp-adapters)的命名就可以看出来。所以我们会看到两个框架针对MCP原语具有不同的表达，我们可以从如下的几个简单的实例来体验一下。

## 1. 无状态的MCP调用

我们利用FastMCP采用如下的方式构建一个MCP服务器，并在其中定义了一个工具、一个静态资源、一个动态资源模板和一个提示词模板。我们最终以Streamable-Http协议将其作为一个Web服务器在本地启动。

```python
from fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("Greeting")

@mcp.tool()
async def greet(name: str) -> str:
    """Get a greeting message for the given name"""
    return f"Hi, {name}!"

@mcp.resource("greeting://everyone")
async def greet_everyone() -> str:
    """Get a greeting message for everyone"""
    return f"Hey, everyone!"    

@mcp.resource("greeting://{name}")
async def greet_to_name(name: str) -> str:
    """Get a greeting message for the given name"""
    return f"Hello, {name}!"

@mcp.prompt()
async def greet_prompt(name: str) -> str:
    """Get a greeting message for the given name"""
    return f"Hi, {name}!"

mcp.run(transport="streamable-http",host="0.0.0.0")
```

在如下的客户端程序中，我们创建了一个`MultiServerMCPClient`对象，它针对多个MCP服务器的连接通过`__init__`方法的`connection`参数进行配置，该参数是一个字典，它的Key用于对MCP服务器进行命名，Value表示针对不同传输协议的连接配置。很明显，我们提供的配置旨在连接上面这个MCP服务器。

```python
from langchain_mcp_adapters.client import MultiServerMCPClient
from langchain_core.messages import AnyMessage
import asyncio

async def main(): 
    client = MultiServerMCPClient(
        connections={
            "greeting": {
                "transport": "streamable_http",
                "url": "http://localhost:8000/mcp"
            }
        }
    )

    # Get tools from the "greeting" server
    tools = await client.get_tools(server_name="greeting")
    print("Get all tools:")
    for tool in tools:
        print(f"""\
    name: {tool.name}, 
    description: {tool.description}
    args: {tool.args}""")
        
    # Call the tool with arguments
    tool = tools[0]
    result = await tool.ainvoke(input={"name": "MCP"})
    print(f"""
Call tool '{tool.name}' with arguments {{'name': 'MCP'}} :
{result[0]['text']}""")
        
    # Get all resources from the "greeting" server
    resources = await client.get_resources(server_name="greeting")
    print("\nGet all resources:")
    for resource in resources:
        print(f"""\
    uri: {resource.metadata["uri"]},
    mimetype: {resource.mimetype}
    data: {resource.data}""")

    print("\nGet resource with URI 'greeting://MCP':") 
    resources = await client.get_resources(server_name="greeting", uris=["greeting://MCP"])
    resource = resources[0]
    print(f"""\
    uri: {resource.metadata["uri"]},
    mimetype: {resource.mimetype}
    data: {resource.data}""")

    print("\nGet prompt 'greet_prompt' with arguments {{'name': 'MCP'}}")
    prompts = await client.get_prompt(server_name="greeting",prompt_name="greet_prompt",arguments={"name": "MCP"})
    prompt: AnyMessage = prompts[0]
    print(f"""\
    type: {prompt.type},
    content: {prompt.content}""")

asyncio.run(main())
```

输出：

```
Get tools from 'greeting' server:
    name: greet, 
    description: Get a greeting message for the given name
    args: {'name': {'type': 'string'}}

Call tool 'greet' with arguments {'name': 'MCP'} :
Hi, MCP!

Get all resources from 'greeting' server:
    uri: greeting://everyone,
    mimetype: text/plain
    data: Hey, everyone!

Get resource with URI 'greeting://MCP' from 'greeting' server:
    uri: greeting://MCP,
    mimetype: text/plain
    data: Hello, MCP!

Get prompt 'greet_prompt' from 'greeting' server:
    type: human,
    content: Hi, MCP!
```

我们演示了`MultiServerMCPClient`的几个核心操作：
- 读取工具列表：我们调用`get_tools`方法指定服务器名称获取可用的工具列表。该方法会直接将返回的工具转换成LangChain的`BaseTool`对象；
- 调用工具：`MultiServerMCPClient`并没有定义一个`call_tool`方法，因为返回的`BaseTool`对象自身就是一个可执行的`Runnable`对象，所以我们可用直接调用`ainvoke`方法传入参数调用它；
- 获取静态资源列表：我们调用`get_resources`方法从指定的服务器中提取可用的静态资源，返回的资源被转换成一个`Blob`对象；
- 获取指定资源：我们调用`get_resources`显式指定URI得到某个具体的资源；
- 渲染提示词：我们调用`get_prompt`方法指定服务器名称、提示词名称和填充参数得到完整提示词。对于Chat模型来说，提示词就是一条或者多条`AIMessage`或者`HumanMessage`；

## 2. 基于Session的MCP调用

默认情况下，针对`MultiServerMCPClient`的方法调用完全是无状态的。每次调用都会创建一个新的Session，并在操作完成后关闭Session。如果需要在MCP Session维护的上下文中完成某些操作，可以调用`session`创建一个Session，该方法返回代表客户端Session的`ClientSession`对象。这个`ClientSession`由[mcp库](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol)提供，MCP规范定义一个客户端操作基本上都能在此类型中找到对应的方法。[langchain_mcp_adapters库](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain-mcp-adapters)所谓的“适配”可以理解为ClientSession与LangChain编程模式的适配，因为所有的操作最终都通过调用`ClientSession`的某个方法来完成。

```python
from langchain_mcp_adapters.client import MultiServerMCPClient
from langchain_mcp_adapters.tools import load_mcp_tools
from langchain_mcp_adapters.resources import load_mcp_resources
from langchain_mcp_adapters.prompts import load_mcp_prompt
from langchain_core.messages import AnyMessage
import asyncio

async def main():
    client = MultiServerMCPClient(
        {
            "greeting": {
                "transport": "streamable_http",
                "url": "http://localhost:8000/mcp",
            }
        }
    )

    async with client.session("greeting") as session:
        # Get tools from the "greeting" server
        tools = await load_mcp_tools(session)
        print("Get all tools:")
        for tool in tools:
            print(
                f"""\
        name: {tool.name}, 
        description: {tool.description}
        args: {tool.args}"""
            )

        # Call the tool with arguments
        tool = tools[0]
        result = await tool.ainvoke(input={"name": "MCP"})
        print(
            f"""
Call tool '{tool.name}' with arguments {{'name': 'MCP'}} :
{result[0]['text']}"""
        )

        # Get all resources from the "greeting" server
        resources = await load_mcp_resources(session)
        print("\nGet all resources:")
        for resource in resources:
            print(f"""\
    uri: {resource.metadata["uri"]},
    mimetype: {resource.mimetype}
    data: {resource.data}""")

        print("\nGet resource with URI 'greeting://MCP':")
        resources = await load_mcp_resources(session, uris=["greeting://MCP"])
        resource = resources[0]
        print(f"""\
    uri: {resource.metadata["uri"]},
    mimetype: {resource.mimetype}
    data: {resource.data}""")

        print("\nGet prompt 'greet_prompt' with arguments {{'name': 'MCP'}}")
        prompts = await load_mcp_prompt(
            session, name="greet_prompt", arguments={"name": "MCP"}
        )
        prompt: AnyMessage = prompts[0]
        print(f"""\
    type: {prompt.type},
    content: {prompt.content}""")

asyncio.run(main())
```

我们会得到一样的输出：

```
Get all tools:
        name: greet, 
        description: Get a greeting message for the given name
        args: {'name': {'type': 'string'}}

Call tool 'greet' with arguments {'name': 'MCP'} :
Hi, MCP!

Get all resources:
        uri: greeting://everyone,
        mimetype: text/plain
        data: Hey, everyone!

Get resource with URI 'greeting://MCP':
        uri: greeting://MCP,
        mimetype: text/plain
        data: Hello, MCP!

Get prompt 'greet_prompt' with arguments {{'name': 'MCP'}}
        type: human,
        content: Hi, MCP!
```

我们通过如上的改动将原来直接调用`MultiServerMCPClient`的方式，改成基于Session的交互模式：

- 我们调用`MultiServerMCPClient`的`session`方法根据指定的服务器创建了一个`ClientSession`对象；
- 我们将针对`MultiServerMCPClient`方法(`get_tools`、`get_resources`和`get_prompt`)调用替换成对应的全局函数(`load_mcp_tools`、`load_mcp_resources`和`load_mcp_prompt`)的调用，它们将`ClientSession`对象作为参数；

## 3. 构建智能私人助理

接下来我们来演示一个完整应该：我们会创建一个Agent作为个人私人助理，并利用它来安排出差行程。我们对它下达出差的指令，并提供出差的城市和周期，它会查看我们的工作日历确定是否与目前的任务安排有冲突。在确定行程可行的基础上，Agent自动完成预定酒店和购买机票的任务。我们使用FastMCP构建一个MCP服务器，上述的三项任务体现在注册的三个工具（`check_calendar`、`book_hotel`和`buy_flight_ticket`）上：

```python
from fastmcp import FastMCP, Context
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime,date, timedelta

server = FastMCP("Server")

@dataclass
class TaskArrangement:
    """Represents a task arrangement scheduled during specified time span."""
    start:datetime
    """The start time of the task."""
    end:datetime
    """The end time of the task."""
    task:str
    """The task to be performed during the time span."""
@dataclass
class ProcessResult:
    """Represents the result of a process."""
    success:bool
    """Indicates whether the process was successful."""
    details:str
    """Additional details about the process result."""

@server.tool
async def check_calendar(date: date) -> list[TaskArrangement]|None:
    """Check the calendar for a specific date and return the scheduled tasks."""
    if date == (datetime.today() + timedelta(days=1)).date():
        return [
            TaskArrangement(
                start=datetime(2024, 6, 1, 9, 0),
                end=datetime(2024, 6, 1, 10, 0),
                task="Team Meeting"
            ),
            TaskArrangement(
                start=datetime(2024, 6, 1, 14, 0),
                end=datetime(2024, 6, 1, 15, 0),
                task="Project Update"
            )
        ]
    else:
        return None

@server.tool
async def book_hotel(check_in: date, check_out: date, city: str) -> ProcessResult:
    """Book a hotel room for the specified dates and city."""
    if city.lower() == "chengdu" and check_in >= datetime.today().date():
        return ProcessResult(
            success=True,
            details=f"Hotel booked in {city} from {check_in} to {check_out}."
        )
    else:
        return ProcessResult(
            success=False,
            details="Unable to book hotel. Please check the city and dates."
        )

@server.tool
async def buy_flight_ticket(departure: str, destination: str, date: date) -> ProcessResult:
    """Buy a flight ticket for the specified route and date."""
    if departure.lower() == "suzhou" and destination.lower() == "chengdu" and date >= datetime.today().date():
        return ProcessResult(
            success=True,
            details=f"Flight booked from {departure} to {destination} on {date}."
        )
    else:
        return ProcessResult(
            success=False,
            details="Unable to book flight. Please check the departure, destination, and date."
        )
    
server.run(transport="streamable-http",host="0.0.0.0")
```

如下是作为私人助理的Agent定义。我们创建了一个`MultiServerMCPClient`对象连接上面这个MCP服务器，并调用它的`get_tools`方法获取可用的工具列表。我们调用`create_agent`函数基于`ChatOpenAI`模型（`gpt-5.2-chat`）将Agent创建出来，同时注册了工具并指定了系统提示词。我们指定提示词调用Agent的`ainvoke`方法下达了到明后两天去成都出差的指令，并将整个执行流程涉及的交谈历史输出来。

```python
from langchain_mcp_adapters.client import MultiServerMCPClient
from langchain.agents import create_agent
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
import asyncio

load_dotenv()

async def main(): 
    client = MultiServerMCPClient(
       connections= {
            "greeting": {
                "transport": "streamable_http",
                "url": "http://localhost:8000/mcp"
            }
        }
    )

    system_prompt = (
        "You are a professional personal assistant that help me to perform business trip based affairs. You can call tools to check calendar, book hotels and flights, etc. "
        "When you receive a business trip related request, you must first call tools to check availability."
        "Once you confirm the availability, you can call tools to book hotels and flights without my confirmation. "
    )  
    tools= await client.get_tools()
    agent = create_agent(
        model=ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-5.2-chat"),     
        tools= tools,
        system_prompt= system_prompt
    )
    
    prompt = "I have a business trip to Chengdu (from Suzhou) from tomorrow to the day after tomorrow, please help me to check the calendar and book the hotel and flight tickets."
    result = await agent.ainvoke(
        input={
            "messages": [
               {
                   "type": "user",
                   "content": prompt
               }
            ]
        })
    
    for message in result["messages"]:
        message.pretty_print()

asyncio.run(main())
```

从输出结果可以看出，Agent完全按照我们希望的流程在工作：

- Agent从请求中提取出有效信息：出差周期（明后两天），目的地（成都）和出发地（苏州）；
- 调用`check_calendar`工具确认行程是否可行；
- 在得到行程可行的情况下，由于系统提示词明确告诉它可以在不经过我的确认情况下，可以自动帮助我预订酒店和购买机票，所以它会通过调用`order_hotel`和`buy_flight_ticket`工具并行完成这三项任务（购买的是往返机票）；
- 按照工具的定义，酒店预订和去程机票购买能够成功完成，但返程机票无法购买。Agent据此还提供了建议：是否选择临近城市；
